name: 李家瑜
objective:
本課程旨在幫助學生提升對全球永續發展目標（SDGs）及當前全球性議題的理解，並能夠用英文進行有效的溝通與表達。學生將學會如何以英文探討全球性問題，如貧窮、氣候變遷、性別平等等，並能在學術、專業及公共討論中自信地發表意見。
This course aims to help students enhance their understanding of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and current global issues, while enabling them to communicate and express their ideas effectively in English. Students will learn how to discuss global issues such as poverty, climate change, and gender equality in English, and confidently express their opinions in academic, professional, and public discussions.
課程進度(1-16週):
W1 Class Introduction + Intro to SDGs
W2 Goal 1: No Poverty
W3 Goal 1: No Poverty
W4 National Holiday (9/28 教師節) Goal 1 Forum writing
W5 Goal 2: Zero Hunger
W6 Goal 2: Zero Hunger + Forum writing
W7 Goal 3: Good Health and Well-Bing + GEPT Practice
W8 National Holiday (10/26 光復節補假) Goal 3 Forum writing
W9 Campus-Wide Exam 
W10 Campus Holiday (11/9 校慶補假)
W11 Goal 4: Quality Education
W12 Goal 4: Quality Education + Forum writing
W13 Goal 5: Gender Equality
W14 Goal 5: Gender Equality + Forum writing
W15 Review + Group Presentation
W16 Review + Group Presentation
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Each group will give a proposal on a selected issue in week 17, discuss key ideas and how they will achieve SDGs with group members, and work together to design an SDG awareness poster.

In week 18, each group will finalize and submit its SDG proposed poster based on the discussion and ideas developed in Week 17.

(1) 第 17 週: 各組針對自選 SDGs 目標報告，分組討論並製作 SDGs 宣傳海報。
(2) 第 18 週: 針對 17 週各組討論結果，各組繳交一份宣傳海報。
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          4
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          Each group will produce and submit a digital awareness poster based on its selected SDG.
各組根據自選之 SDGs 目標主題，繳交一份電子宣傳海報。
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          (1) The presentation of the SDG poster 5% SDGs 海報呈現 5%

(2) Team participation and contribution 5% 團隊參與 5%

This course is designed as an English for Specific Purposes / English for Academic Purposes (ESP/EAP) course. All course materials, handouts, and presentation slides will be provided in English. English will be used for at least 80% of classroom instruction and teacher–student interaction.

本課程為專業英文（ESP/EAP）課程，教材、講義及簡報均採全英文；課堂授課及師生互動之英語使用比例 80% (含) 以上。

延伸教學與資源: ● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG1：消除貧窮（No Poverty）SDG2：消除飢餓（Zero Hunger）SDG3：良好健康和福祉（Good Health and Well-being）SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG5：性別平等（Gender Equality）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）
